channel.description: Latest articles from Best Little Sites (comicbookmovie.com)

item.title: WONDER MAN Complete Series Review: "A Wholly Unique MCU Experience Anchored By A Bromance For The Ages"
item.description: The review embargo for Marvel Studios' Wonder Man has officially lifted! Come read what this reviewer thought of the latest MCU series starring Yahya Abdul-Mateen II and Sir Ben Kingsley!

item.title: Does WONDER MAN Have A Post-Credits Scene? Here's Your Spoiler-Free Answer!
item.description: Ahead of Wonder Man's premiere on Disney+ next week, we have a spoiler-free breakdown of whether the latest MCU TV series has a mid- or post-credits scene.

item.title: April Pool's Day Returns With New DEADPOOL One-Shot By Gail Simone And Must-See Variant Covers
item.description: Marvel Comics has shared a first look at the upcoming Deadpool: April Pool's Day one-shot, along with two wild April Pool's Day-themed variant covers.

item.title: WONDER MAN Is The Best-Reviewed MCU TV Series In FOUR YEARS Based On Rotten Tomatoes Score
item.description: The first critic verdicts for Wonder Man have arrived, and it's now the best-reviewed MCU TV series since 2022, and the second highest-ranked show on the review aggregator.

item.title: MASTERS OF THE UNIVERSE Branded "Woke Garbage" Because Of "He/Him" Pronouns Joke In First Trailer
item.description: The first trailer for Masters of the Universe received a largely positive response, but the movie is being branded "woke garbage" due to a joke about He-Man's pronouns.

item.title: SUPERGIRL: James Gunn Officially Reveals Jason Momoa's Lobo In New Teaser For The Movie
item.description: DC Studios co-CEO James Gunn has shared a new teaser for Supergirl, finally revealing our first full look at Jason Momoa as the DCU's Scourge o' the Cosmos, Lobo.

item.title: 6 Ways The Marvel Cinematic Universe Must Evolve For The Post-AVENGERS: SECRET WARS Reboot
item.description: With it looking increasingly likely that the MCU will be softly rebooted after Avengers: Secret Wars, we have some thoughts on how the franchise should evolve with a fresh start.

item.title: SUPERGIRL Promo Posters Feature An Even Better Look At Jason Momoa's Transformation Into Lobo
item.description: Two new Supergirl promo posters have been released, offering DC Comics fans a much better look at Jason Momoa's comic-accurate transformation into the DCU's Main Man, Lobo.

item.title: WONDER MAN's Rotten Tomatoes Score Revealed As Latest MCU TV Series Is Officially "Certified Fresh"
item.description: Wonder Man has been officially "Certified Fresh" by Rotten Tomatoes, and with that comes an updated Tomatometer score. We also have a new TV spot for the critically acclaimed MCU TV series.
